messages:
ellie-marketing: Quick ask for next week's webinar promotional pack — minimal, engineer-friendly, and deployable across socials + webinar landing. Need first drafts in ~48h.
- Deliverables: 3 social tiles (square, landscape hero, story), 1 three-panel explainer slide (inference economics), 1 inbound routing microdiagram (CTA -> LP -> nurture -> SDR), and a one-line event header for emails.
- Specs: export PNGs at 1x and 2x, 16:9 master slide, mobile-first constraints, include Figma .fig. Brand: primary lockup on hero, stacked lockup on tiles, accessibility contrast required.

Priority list: explainer slide > routing microdiagram > social tiles > header copy.

priya-design: Got it. Two questions: do we want a data-oriented aesthetic (sparklines, token-cost numbers) or more conceptual (icons + motion-friendly shapes)? Also, any mandatory legal footnote for the webinar (e.g., not financial advice)?

ellie-marketing: Favor data-oriented but keep simple. Include one slide variant with raw metric callouts (e.g., tokens/sec, $/k tokens) and a conceptual variant with icons. Legal: tiny footer "claims illustrative; actual costs depend on usage" — yes include.

marco-motion: I can produce motion-friendly frames and a 6s hero loop for the social story. Will keep assets as separate layers so exports work for PNG keyframes. Planning to animate: token sparkline -> cost fade -> CTA pulse. Will deliver keyframes + a 1080x1920 MP4 stub.

noah-growth: For inbound routing microdiagram, include suggested UTM pattern and sample subject lines for email nurture. UTM: ?utm_source=webinar&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=inference_launch_v1. Subject tester A: "Watch: How to cut inference costs by 3x" — B: "Live demo: predictable LLM inference economics".

priya-design: Copy for tiles — short lead options: "Serve inference predictably", "Ship LLM features, not surprises", and "Cut per-token cost without sacrificing latency". Which tone? concise-technical.

ellie-marketing: Use concise-technical. Pick the second for social hero. Also include alt copy lines for A/B testing.

design-bot: AUTO-EXPORT CHECKLIST: Uploaded Figma link required. Required artboards: 1080x1080, 1200x628, 1080x1920, 1920x1080. Exports: PNG-1x, PNG-2x, MP4 (story), layered .fig, and a PDF master. Include color tokens and font files. Accessibility: provide AA-compliant color pair for all hero/variant combos.

priya-design: Starting comps now. I'll push two directions into the Figma file — "Metric-first" and "Icon-clarity". tagging @marco-motion for motion frames. ETA: first frames by Tue EOD.

marco-motion: On it. I'll sync with Priya on layer naming to ensure clean exports for social animators. Will also include simple Lottie fallback JSON for our web hero.

noah-growth: I'll prep the UTM-tracking spreadsheet and sample nurture cadence (3 emails + 1 demo follow-up). Will also stub the landing page CTA copy and sample feature bullets.

ellie-marketing: Great. Let's do a quick check-in tomorrow 10:30am PT. Thanks everyone 8522; prioritizing the explainer slide and routing diagram first.
